subject: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount — MediqHealth
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing ask + SOW (MediqHealth)

Sarah — great to meet yesterday. Per our conversation MediqHealth is interested in a multi-year Hosted API commitment to replace several internal models and consolidate inference with Redwood. Key items: 3-year term, anticipated steady-state usage ~1.2B tokens/month after ramp, and need for enterprise SLAs and extra data-retention controls.

As discussed, procurement is asking for meaningful unit price relief to make the business case; they asked whether we can go below our standard list by ~30% (net). This is outside our playbook (>20% requires exec sign-off).

Attached: SOW (detailed milestones), usage forecast, and a quick side-by-side pricing matrix.

Recommended internal path: escalate to Marcus for one-time exec approval for a limited concession with performance milestones and minimum monthly committed spend. Ben

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOW_MediqHealth_2026.pdf (application/pdf); Mediq_usage_forecast_Q4-2026.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@mediqhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing ask + SOW (MediqHealth)

Ben — thanks for the quick follow-up and for sharing the SOW. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- We expect a faster ramp: pilot next month, production in Q4. The 1.2B tokens/month is conservative for year 2.
- Procurement needs pricing and legal terms to finalize the PO by Sep 3.
- If Redwood can approve a deeper discount in exchange for a 36-month lock and a 15% prepay, that will move this forward.

Tom (cc) will own the PO and vendor checklist. Please let us know what you can commit to by end of week.

—
Sarah Kim
VP, Digital Platforms | MediqHealth
sarah.kim@mediqhealth.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Hosted API pricing ask + SOW (MediqHealth) — escalation for >20% approval

Team — forwarding MediqHealth thread and the attached forecast. Ben is requesting exec-level approval for a concession well north of our standard thresholds: the external ask is ~30% off list, with a proposed 36-month lock and 15% prepay.

Quick internal summary / numbers (high level):
- ARR at ask: ~$5.8M first 12 months (post-ramp), ~19M over 3 years at forecasted usage.
- Gross margin impact at 30% discount to list: ~-9 percentage points vs standard hosted unit economics (before any efficiency gains from caching/quantization).
- Upside: strategic reference in healthcare vertical, potential marketplace listing, and possible expansion into private deployment for regulated customers at premium rates.

Recommended compromise for approval:
1) Offer 25% net discount (not cumulative with other promo credits) for first 24 months; after month 24 revert to standard list;
2) Require a minimum committed monthly spend that ensures a 15% effective prepay (locked as minimum ARR) and quarterly usage reviews tied to rollback triggers if they under-deliver;
3) Attach standard security addendum and SOC2 evidence; finance/legal to sign an exception letter and cap the concession to the attached SOW only.

Rationale: preserves runway and gives the customer enough headroom to commit while limiting long-term margin erosion. This request requires Marcus' sign-off (senior sales exec) and Ops/Finance to accept the non-standard billing cadence.

Attachments: pricing-side-by-side.pdf (internal pricing comparison)

Please advise approval or counter. If we have Marcus' uplift by EOD Thursday we can meet Mediq procurement timeline.

—
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0198
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Hosted API pricing ask + SOW (MediqHealth) — escalation for >20% approval

Thanks for the clear summary, Olga. I approve a one-time concession of 25% net on Hosted API list price under the following conditions:
1) Term length: 24 months guaranteed minimum (we will not extend the concession past month 24);
2) Minimum committed spend: $3.5M ARR (first 12 months equivalent) to be formalized in SOW;
3) 15% prepay or equivalent financial guarantee to be captured in the order form;
4) Legal to prepare an exception letter limiting the concession to the SOW and including rollback triggers for sustained under-delivery;
5) Security/Compliance sign-off on SOC2 evidence (Ops to confirm) prior to go-live.

Finance: please prepare a one-page approval memo and update revenue recognition notes for the deal. Once legal drafts the amendment, I give authorization to finalize. This is an important strategic account — I want the relationship managed tightly but we should move to close.

Marcus
Vice President, Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0177
